n96e8fa0e1b.headline: UPDATES: After IAEA Resolution Over Its Non-Compliance, Iran Steps Up Production of 60% Uranium
n96e8fa0e1b.summary: Iran is stepping up production of 60% uranium after the IAEA's 35-nation Board of Governors passed a resolution demanding an end to obstruction of inspections. The vote was overwhelming.
n96e8fa0e1b.why: Iran's nuclear programme drives sanctions, regional security risk and energy-market sentiment in the Middle East.

n54dce2d07f.headline: G7 countries, Australia set Russian oil price cap at $60 per barrel
n54dce2d07f.summary: G7 countries and Australia agreed to set a price cap of $60 per barrel on Russian oil. The move followed a political agreement reached by EU members after resistance from Poland.
n54dce2d07f.why: Price caps on Russian crude limit the revenue Moscow can earn from seaborne oil sales, and they shape global crude flows and benchmark prices.
n54dce2d07f.why_moved: The price cap sets a ceiling on what Western buyers and service providers can pay for Russian oil, which affects global crude supply and pricing expectations.

n34306e1493.headline: Ukraine: Presses for reduction to 30 dollars on the Russian oil price cap - HuffPost - News and Opinions from Greece and the World
n34306e1493.summary: A Ukrainian official stated that lowering the Russian oil price cap to $30 would accelerate damage to Russia's economy.
n34306e1493.why: Price caps on Russian oil aim to limit revenue funding Russia's war efforts, affecting global oil markets and geopolitical dynamics.
